title: Quiet ruleset
description: Drives which page elements are hidden, on which sites. Shipped bundled inside the app and updatable at runtime. Contains data only: CSS selectors and match patterns, never executable code.

schemaVersion.description: Shape of this document. An engine refuses any ruleset whose schemaVersion it does not understand and falls back to its bundled copy.

rulesetVersion.description: Content version. Increases every time selectors change. A remote ruleset is adopted only if this is higher than the bundled one.

id.description: Stable identifier. Never change it: user preferences are keyed on it.
site-id.feature-id. Stable forever. Selectors underneath may change freely; this may not.

appliesTo.description: Optional path globs. Absent means every page on the site. Matched against pathname plus search.

verify.description: Selectors that must exist on a healthy page. Used by Tools/check-selectors to tell 'the site changed its DOM' apart from 'this feature is not present on this page'.

selector.description: A CSS selector. Characters that could break out of a stylesheet rule or a comment are forbidden. The child combinator > and the sibling combinators ~ and + stay legal.

matchPattern.description: WebExtension style match pattern, restricted to http and https.
